comment: Ms. Latane is really just the greatest woman ever, she's the funniest person and says the strangest stuff. Take her! Super laid back and great gal

Dawn is a good artist, who really knows what she's doing. As a teacher, however, she tends to ramble and is incredibly unorganized overall. She doesn't ever give out any kind of schedule andI wonder if she's forgotten what assignments she's given out. She told me that a paper was due on Wednesday, when it was due Monday. Good teacher, but watch out

She's a good teacher overall, really knows her stuff and tries to get all her students to improve.  However, she doesn't really encourage creativity or students' own ideas, and if your piece isn't going how she thinks it should, she will come over and work on it for like 30 minutes, which is irritating. She tends to ramble and talk a lot too.
Great drawing professor. Her Foundation Drawing class helped me a lot with my technique in varying mediums. Great class, I highly recommend it.
